runs.text: According to the text, the following drugs in the clinical trial table use lipid-based nanocarriers:

runs.quote: NBF-006, and EphA2 siRNA-all five utilize lipid-based nanocarriers,

runs.text: The text adds that these use lipid formulations such as lipid nanoparticles (LNPs), liposomes, and DOPC. The table entries agree: Atu027 is listed with liposomes, TKM-080301, DCR-MYC and NBF-006 with LNPs, and EphA2 siRNA with DOPC.
